evidence: The body first calls f_7000f974c0 and returns 0 unless its result equals 3. On the accepted path it reads get_attribute_context_status_32, passes its low byte to three unresolved helpers, and returns 1 when the low byte of the third helper result plus the low byte of the second is not less than the first helper result minus 1; otherwise it returns 0. Helper result domains are unknown. decompiled/main/main_0112.c:28985-29012. Indexed callers store the result at stack offsets 0x44 and 0x3c (main_0112.c:47355-47356, 47441-47442); another caller stores it at +0x148 (main_0112.c:26786-26787).

Initializes the caller output to -1, resolves an attribute object from the global context path, and calls the accepted player_attribute_get_float helper with selector 0x5e. If the resolved object pointer is absent, it first invokes f_700183f6e4, then performs the same selector read. The returned float is converted to a 32-bit signed integer and written to the output. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:55191-55225. No indexed caller is available.

Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX and checks bit 28 of the 32-bit value loaded through global pointer 0x7003b25000+0x460 at offset 0x26584. Only when bit 28 is set does it resolve the context object, fall back through f_700183f6e4 if its attribute pointer is absent, call accepted player_attribute_get_float with selector 5, convert the result to signed 32-bit integer, and store it. decompiled/main/main_0123.c:50322-50352. No indexed caller is available.

Initializes the caller output to UINT32_MAX and returns with that value when bit 26 is set in the global configuration word loaded through 0x7003b25000+0x460 at offset 0x26584. Otherwise it resolves the context object, falls back through f_700183f6e4 if needed, calls accepted player_attribute_get_float with selector 0x39, converts the result to signed 32-bit integer, and stores it. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:25192-25227. No indexed caller is available.
